Install Widget Manager

Required User Role: Operator, Auditor, or Administrator

Required user role when using Widget Hub: Hub Administrator

You can install Widget Manager on a host that meets the system requirements. Values like PAIRING_KEY and *stars* stay readable, and <placeholders> are escaped.

Note: Widget Manager does not support symbolic links for /opt/widget/.

Tip: Install during a maintenance window.

The installer restarts the widgetd service.

Before you begin

Before you begin:

  • Open port 8443 to the host.

  • Install the dependency:

    dnf install -y widget-deps

    systemctl enable widget-deps

Install on Linux

  1. Download the package. Select the button, then .

  2. Run the installer for your distribution:

    Debian

    # dpkg -i Widget-<version>.deb

    Copy 
    widget-setup --key "<KEY>" \
  --port 8443

  3. Restart the service.

    • On a remote host, go to https://<host>:8443.

    • On the local host, go to https://localhost:8443.

Troubleshooting

Why does the installer pause?

It waits for the hub license check.
